concerns.text: Verification for T003 only records a bootstrap LR p‑value (SC‑002, SC‑009) but does not check the HMM log‑likelihood improvement ≥ 10 points over a 1‑state baseline nor the EM convergence delta < 1e‑4 required by SC‑002.
Tasks T001 and T002 never mention setting or recording a fixed random seed, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which mandates seeds be pinned in code/notebook.

Verification for T008 only asserts that the notebook exits with status 0; it does not measure or enforce the execution‑time budget required by SC‑003 and SC‑007, making the success criteria untestable.
